children: Shares of Bioventus fell after the company cut its outlook and reported sales in the third quarter that missed analyst expectations.
The stock fell 11% to $11.75 in after-hours trading on Monday. Shares closed down 1.3% at $13.15 and had risen 77% year-to-date through the close.
The company on Monday reported a profit of $6 million, or 8 cents a share, compared with a profit of $3.2 million, or 5 cents a share, a year earlier.
Stripping out certain one-time items, adjusted earnings were 17 cents a share. Analysts polled by FactSet were expecting 15 cents a share.
Net sales rose to $142.4 million from $138.7 million. Analysts had been expecting $149.5 million.

Bioventus also cut its net sales outlook for the full year. It projected 2026 net sales of between $590 million and $595 million, down from previous guidance in a range of $600 million to $610 million. Analysts currently expect $604.8 million in net sales.
The company reaffirmed its guidance for adjusted earnings this year between 75 cents and 79 cents a share. Analysts are expecting 78 cents a share.
